sloka: दुर्बुद्धेस्तस्य राजेन्द्र तव विप्रियकारिणः ।वधमाज्ञापय क्षिप्रं यथा ऽसौ विलयं व्रजेत् ।। ५.५८.११२ ।।।।
transliteration: durbuddhestasya rājendra tava vipriyakāriṇaḥ ।vadhamājñāpaya kṣipraṁ yathā 'sau vilayaṁ vrajet ।। 5.58.112 ।।।।

translations.english: 'O king may orders be issued to kill this wickedminded vanara wandering aimlessly. He has done contrary to your interest.
